title: Retired Analytics Config
content_html:
Retired Analytics Config

The former Analytics source and runtime configuration were removed with the application. This page is a retirement record, not an editable configuration contract.

Current owners:

  • Studio routes and browser-safe data paths: studio/app/frontend/config/studio-config.json;
  • tag group order and coverage/RAG policy: studio/data/config/tags/tag-management.json;
  • tag API projection and editor settings: studio/app/server/studio/studio_app_config.py;
  • exact current configuration map: Configuration Map.

Do not recreate the former config file, runtime payload, environment family, or route registry as a compatibility layer.
